documents.title: Synthetic Training Policy
documents.text:
SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY — not real company policy.

Protected training blocks are planned learning time. When a block is converted to floor coverage, record the converted hours and the coverage reason. Review incomplete training with the store manager; this demo does not authorize automated schedule changes.
